alternating_hamilton_cycle_theorem.title: Alternating hamiltonian circuit in two-coloured complete graphs
alternating_hamilton_cycle_theorem.publication: Theory of Graphs (Proc. Colloq., Tihany, 1966), Academic Press, 1968, pp. 11-18
alternating_hamilton_cycle_theorem.use: an even-order 2-edge-colored complete graph has an alternating Hamilton cycle iff it has an alternating cycle factor and the disjoint equal-size degree-sum inequalities are strict

fault_hamiltonicity_input.claim: in both colors every induced order-28 subgraph is traceable and every induced order at least 29 is Hamiltonian

connectivity_input.claim: underlying target-specific source for the fault-Hamiltonicity theorem
